requirement: Implement a service test mock builder create_repository_mock that enforces strict signature validation against the target interface UserRepository. Mocks must reject non-existent methods and invalid call signatures (missing required args, unknown kwargs) with TypeError or AttributeError using autospec=True / create_autospec.
skeleton: Interface class UserRepository and factory build_user_repo_mock().

rationale.teaches: A repository mock built with create_autospec instance=True, so unknown methods raise AttributeError and wrong signatures raise TypeError, with return values set on the autospecced method and errors propagated.
rationale.why: A plain Mock accepts any method and any arguments, so a test against it passes even after the interface changes. The fixture calls a non-existent method and a wrong signature and expects errors.

candidates.why_wrong: A bare Mock is returned, so any method name and any arguments are accepted.
spec without autospec checks attribute names but not signatures, so a call with a missing argument passes.
instance=False autospecs the class, so calling the mock returns an instance mock and method calls need self.
find_by_id is replaced with a plain Mock, so its signature is no longer enforced.
TypeError and AttributeError are swallowed and None is returned, so a signature mismatch looks like a successful call.
